content.content: Integration tests live under `tests/` as self-contained files: each pulls in the module under test (`#[path]` shims or the public API) and defines its own fixtures and helpers. There is no shared test-support module.
content.rationale: Cargo compiles each file in `tests/` as its own crate, so shared helpers would need a separate support target. Self-contained files keep every test independently runnable.
